steps.say: Get a repo that uses qq. On Linux, qq fetch clones it and runs qq sync.
This sandbox cannot reach ghcr.io, so we clone and pass Node 24 with --toolchain.

steps.cmd: mkdir -p ~/qq-try && cd ~/qq-try && git clone -q https://github.com/quirq-ai/innernet && echo cloned

steps.say: What does the repo build? Ask qqsync, never parse repo.toml yourself.
Build and test every target, with the pinned toolchain
Results, logs and JUnit XML land in .qq/out
Run the app with the same toolchains first on PATH (Ctrl-C stops it)
